regime_context: US thematic leadership is heavily concentrated at the top of the ranks (AI Infrastructure, Semiconductor Equipment, Memory/HBM, Cybersecurity all durable and trend-healthy), but momentum rank itself is a focus lens with rank-IC ~0 and direction accuracy on this trader's track record is only ~0.49 — no validated forward edge. The one validated leg (absolute-trend gate) is healthy here (gate_helps=true, broad eligible set), so the discipline supports staying in trends rather than timing or fading; conviction should default low.

theses.subject: AI Infrastructure
theses.thesis: AI Infrastructure leads the ranks with high durability (0.73), broad participation (breadth 0.875), quiet valuation state, and a non-crowded position (crowding_z 0.81). This supports a directional lean on trend continuation, NOT a return forecast. The trend-gate is the only validated leg and this theme is eligible.
